name: Tatsumi Naoya
source:
He is Shougo's best friend and a soul mate, who lends him porn movies when he gets them.

He is a good guy, but he is too interested in pornography, and Marina calls him “Erotic Idiot No. 1 and No. 2. By the way, “No. 1” is Shougo.

He knows that Shougo has always had a crush on Shouko. He also senses that Marina has a crush on Shougo.

[From [url=https://www.ail-soft.com/yomi/pro_yomi_cha3.html]official site[/url]]
